This matches the monoisotopic mass of the neutral formula C₁₀H₁₃NO₂ (C = 10 × 12.0000 = 120.0000; H = 13 × 1.007825 = 13.1017; N = 14.0031; O₂ = 2 × 15.9949 = 31.9898; total ≈ 179.0946). The formula C₁₀H₁₃NO₂ gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 5), consistent with a realistic organic molecule. Therefore the sample compound’s molecular formula is C₁₀H₁₃O₂N.</thought>
